title: Hardcoded password
description: Hardcoded password detected. Credentials should never be stored in source code.
suggestion: Use environment variables or a secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

title: Hardcoded API key
description: Hardcoded API key or token detected.
suggestion: Use environment variables or a secrets manager.

title: Hardcoded secret/token
description: Hardcoded secret or authentication token detected.
suggestion: Rotate this secret immediately and use a secrets manager.

title: AWS access key
description: AWS access key ID detected in source code.
suggestion: Remove immediately, rotate the key, and use IAM roles or environment variables.

title: Private key material
description: Private key embedded in source code.
suggestion: Remove the private key and store it in a secure key management system.

title: Generic high-entropy secret
description: High-entropy string assigned to a secret-looking variable.
suggestion: Verify this isn't a real credential. Use environment variables for secrets.

title: SQL injection risk
description: Potential SQL injection via string formatting in query.
suggestion: Use parameterized queries: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?', (id,))

title: Shell injection risk
description: Shell command execution with shell=True enables injection attacks.
suggestion: Use subprocess with shell=False and pass arguments as a list.

title: Command injection via template
description: OS command constructed from user-controlled input.
suggestion: Use subprocess.run() with shell=False and argument lists.

title: eval() usage
description: eval() executes arbitrary code and is a major security risk.
suggestion: Use ast.literal_eval() for safe evaluation, or redesign to avoid eval entirely.

title: Unsafe deserialization
description: Unsafe deserialization can execute arbitrary code.
suggestion: Use yaml.safe_load() or json.loads() instead.

title: innerHTML assignment
description: Direct innerHTML assignment can lead to XSS.
suggestion: Use textContent for text, or sanitize HTML with DOMPurify.

title: SQL string concatenation
description: SQL query built with string concatenation from request data.
suggestion: Use parameterized queries or an ORM.

title: Exec/Function constructor
description: Function constructor creates code from strings, similar to eval().
suggestion: Refactor to use standard function definitions.

title: Go SQL injection
description: SQL query built with string formatting in Go.
suggestion: Use parameterized queries: db.Query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = $1", id)

title: Debug mode enabled
description: Debug mode appears to be enabled. This can expose sensitive information.
suggestion: Ensure debug mode is disabled in production.

title: CORS wildcard
description: CORS configured to allow all origins. This may expose APIs to unauthorized access.
suggestion: Restrict CORS to specific trusted domains.

title: Insecure HTTP URL
description: HTTP URLs detected. Consider using HTTPS.
suggestion: Use HTTPS for all external communications.

title: Disabled SSL verification
description: SSL certificate verification is disabled, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
suggestion: Enable SSL verification (verify=True) and use proper certificate management.

title: Insecure random for security
description: Standard random module is not cryptographically secure.
suggestion: Use secrets module for security-sensitive randomness: secrets.token_hex(), secrets.randbelow().

title: Weak hash algorithm
description: Weak hash algorithm (MD5/SHA1) detected. These are vulnerable to collisions.
suggestion: Use SHA-256 or stronger: hashlib.sha256().

title: Permissive file permissions
description: File permissions set to 777 (world-readable/writable/executable).
suggestion: Use more restrictive permissions (e.g., 0o644 for files, 0o755 for directories).

title: TODO/FIXME/HACK comment
description: Technical debt marker found.
suggestion: Address the TODO/FIXME before merging to main branch.

title: Broad exception catch
description: Catching broad exceptions can hide bugs.
suggestion: Catch specific exceptions (e.g., ValueError, KeyError).

title: Mutable default argument
description: Mutable default argument in function definition. This is a common Python bug.
suggestion: Use None as default and initialize inside the function: def f(x=None): x = x or []

title: Loose equality (==) in JS
description: Loose equality (==) can lead to unexpected type coercion.
suggestion: Use strict equality (===) instead.

title: Console.log in production code
description: console.log() found. Remove before production deployment.
suggestion: Use a proper logging library or remove debug logging.

title: Empty catch block
description: Empty catch/except block swallows errors without a trace.
suggestion: Log the error or handle it explicitly.

title: Synchronous file I/O in async context
description: Synchronous file I/O in an async function blocks the event loop.
suggestion: Use aiofiles or run_in_executor for file I/O in async code.

title: N+1 query pattern
description: Potential N+1 query pattern: database query inside a loop.
suggestion: Use batch queries, JOINs, or prefetch_related/select_related.

title: Regex in loop without compilation
description: Regex used inside a loop without pre-compilation.
suggestion: Compile the regex before the loop: pattern = re.compile(r'...'); pattern.search(text)

title: Unpinned dependency
description: Installing package without version pinning.
suggestion: Pin dependencies to specific versions for reproducible builds.

title: Running as root in Docker
description: Container may be running as root (no USER directive before CMD/ENTRYPOINT).
suggestion: Add a USER directive to run as non-root: USER nonroot

title: Latest tag in Docker FROM
description: Using 'latest' or untagged base image makes builds non-reproducible.
suggestion: Pin to a specific version: FROM python:3.11-slim

title: Public S3 bucket
description: S3 bucket configured with public read access.
suggestion: Use 'private' ACL unless public access is explicitly required.

title: Open security group
description: Security group open to all IPs (0.0.0.0/0).
suggestion: Restrict to specific IP ranges or use a VPN.

title: GitHub personal access token
description: GitHub personal access token detected in source code.
suggestion: Revoke this token at github.com/settings/tokens and use environment variables.

title: Slack webhook URL
description: Slack webhook URL detected in source code.
suggestion: Store webhook URLs in environment variables or a secrets manager.

title: Google API key
description: Google API key detected in source code.
suggestion: Restrict the API key in Google Cloud Console and load from environment variables.

title: Stripe secret key
description: Stripe live secret key detected. This grants full access to payment processing.
suggestion: Revoke this key in the Stripe dashboard immediately and use environment variables.

title: Database connection string with credentials
description: Database connection string with embedded credentials found in source code.
suggestion: Use environment variables for connection strings: os.environ['DATABASE_URL'].

title: Hardcoded Bearer/Authorization token
description: Hardcoded Bearer token in source code.
suggestion: Load authentication tokens from environment variables or a secrets manager.

title: Potential SSRF via requests library
description: HTTP request with user-controlled URL may enable Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
suggestion: Validate and allowlist target URLs/hosts. Use a URL parser to verify the scheme and host.

title: Potential SSRF via fetch/axios
description: HTTP request constructed from user input may enable SSRF attacks.
suggestion: Validate URLs against an allowlist of permitted hosts before making requests.

title: Path traversal via user input
description: File operation with user-controlled path may allow directory traversal attacks.
suggestion: Use os.path.realpath() and verify the resolved path is within the expected base directory.

title: Path traversal in Node.js
description: File system operation with user-controlled path enables path traversal.
suggestion: Use path.resolve() and verify the result starts with the intended base directory.

title: Open redirect in Python web framework
description: Redirect using user-controlled input may allow open redirect attacks.
suggestion: Validate redirect targets against an allowlist of permitted URLs.

title: Open redirect in Express
description: Express redirect using user-supplied input enables open redirect.
suggestion: Validate redirect URLs against an allowlist of permitted paths or hosts.

title: JWT verification disabled
description: JWT verification disabled or 'none' algorithm accepted. Allows forged tokens.
suggestion: Always verify JWT signatures. Explicitly specify allowed algorithms: algorithms=['HS256'].

title: Hardcoded JWT secret
description: JWT signed with a hardcoded secret key.
suggestion: Load the JWT secret from environment variables or a secrets manager.

title: Weak cipher or ECB mode
description: Weak cipher algorithm or insecure ECB block cipher mode detected.
suggestion: Use AES-256-GCM or AES-256-CBC with proper IV. Never use DES, RC4, or ECB mode.

title: Hardcoded initialization vector
description: Hardcoded initialization vector (IV) makes encryption predictable.
suggestion: Generate a random IV for each encryption operation using os.urandom() or crypto.randomBytes().

title: Server-side template injection
description: render_template_string() renders templates from strings, enabling server-side template injection if user input is included.
suggestion: Use render_template() with static template files instead of render_template_string().

title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage
description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML bypasses React's built-in XSS protections.
suggestion: Sanitize HTML with DOMPurify before using dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

title: javascript: URI in href
description: javascript: URIs in href attributes execute arbitrary code (XSS).
suggestion: Validate URLs and reject javascript: protocol. Allow only http: and https: schemes.

title: document.write() usage
description: document.write() can introduce XSS vulnerabilities and blocks page rendering.
suggestion: Use DOM APIs (createElement, textContent) instead of document.write().

title: Django mark_safe with variable input
description: mark_safe() with dynamic content bypasses Django's auto-escaping, enabling XSS.
suggestion: Use format_html() instead of mark_safe() with string formatting.

title: Django raw SQL query
description: Django raw SQL query with string formatting enables SQL injection.
suggestion: Use Django ORM or pass parameters: Model.objects.raw('SELECT ... WHERE id = %s', [id]).

title: Flask SECRET_KEY hardcoded
description: Flask SECRET_KEY is hardcoded. This compromises session security.
suggestion: Load SECRET_KEY from environment variable: app.secret_key = os.environ['SECRET_KEY'].

title: Flask send_file path traversal
description: send_file() with user-controlled path enables arbitrary file read.
suggestion: Use send_from_directory() with a fixed base directory instead.

title: Command injection via child_process
description: Command executed with user-controlled input enables remote code execution.
suggestion: Use execFile/execFileSync with arguments as an array. Never concatenate user input into commands.

title: Node.js TLS verification disabled
description: TLS certificate verification disabled. Enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
suggestion: Enable TLS verification. Use proper CA certificates for self-signed certs.

title: Math.random() for security
description: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure and should not be used for security.
suggestion: Use crypto.randomUUID(), crypto.getRandomValues(), or crypto.randomBytes().

title: Insecure temporary file creation
description: Insecure temporary file creation is vulnerable to race condition attacks.
suggestion: Use tempfile.mkstemp() or tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() instead.

title: Assert used for security validation
description: assert statements are removed when Python runs with -O flag. Never use for security checks.
suggestion: Use if/raise for security: if not user.is_authenticated: raise PermissionError().

title: Unsafe marshal/shelve deserialization
description: marshal and shelve can execute arbitrary code during deserialization.
suggestion: Use json.loads() for untrusted data. Only use marshal/shelve with trusted sources.

title: Privileged Kubernetes container
description: Container running in privileged mode has full host access.
suggestion: Remove privileged: true. Use specific capabilities if needed.

title: Container running as root in Kubernetes
description: Kubernetes pod configured to run as root user.
suggestion: Set runAsNonRoot: true and specify a non-zero runAsUser in securityContext.

title: Kubernetes host namespace sharing
description: Pod shares the host's network/PID/IPC namespace, breaking container isolation.
suggestion: Remove hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC unless absolutely required.

title: Docker ADD instead of COPY
description: ADD instruction used instead of COPY. ADD can auto-extract archives and fetch URLs unexpectedly.
suggestion: Use COPY unless you specifically need ADD's tar extraction or URL fetching features.

title: Secret in Docker ARG/ENV
description: Secret passed via ARG or ENV in Dockerfile. ARG values are visible in docker history.
suggestion: Use Docker BuildKit secrets (--mount=type=secret) or runtime environment variables.

title: Sensitive port exposed in Dockerfile
description: Sensitive service port (SSH/DB/cache) exposed in Dockerfile.
suggestion: Avoid exposing database or management ports. Use Docker networks for inter-service communication.

title: Publicly accessible RDS instance
description: RDS database instance is publicly accessible from the internet.
suggestion: Set publicly_accessible = false and use private subnets with VPN/bastion access.

title: Environment variable leaked in logs
description: Environment variable value written to logs may leak secrets.
suggestion: Never log raw environment variable values. Mask sensitive values before logging.

title: Potential mass assignment
description: Directly passing request body to database operations may allow mass assignment.
suggestion: Explicitly pick allowed fields. Use serializer validation or an allowlist.
